Relationship and family difficulties

Counselling to help you navigate difficult relationships

Difficulties in relationships, whether with a partner, family member, or friend, can leave you feeling hurt, confused, or stuck. Counselling can help you explore the patterns and feelings that affect how you relate to others, and work towards greater understanding and more fulfilling connections.

Sometimes it is not a specific event but a slow erosion of connection, communication, or trust. Other times it is a sudden crisis — divorce, separation, bereavement, or conflict — that brings everything to a head.

Whatever the situation, I can offer a space to think things through, understand your own role in the dynamic, and find a way forward that feels right for you.
